domains.use: Create the café espresso machine as a validated mesh.cube source document. Its real vertex and face geometry is projected into the counter illustration.

gameOwned.simulation: Deterministic café service queue, patience, recipe progress, rush clock, and upgrades; independent of rendering and input.
gameOwned.input: Keyboard action codes and accessible action buttons mapped to café prep steps.
gameOwned.rendering: Canvas 2D illustration and DOM ticket board; the espresso machine uses NexusEngine-authored mesh geometry.
